lines.text: Example one: a ready template. The list is NIFTY 50 stocks, and the chart is Daily.
In Start a scan, tap Template, then Momentum.
Two conditions fill in: RSI 14 above 60, and the close above its 20-bar EMA. These numbers are example settings, not recommendations.
Press Run.
The header shows Matched N of 50. The count beside each condition shows how many stayed in after it.
Show on chart, on a match, explains why it matched, condition by condition.
Read Why it matched: the RSI value, and the close against the average, at the matched candle.
Information and education only, not investment advice.
Example two: build your own. Pick a list, here F and O stocks, on Daily.
Tap Template, then Blank: I add conditions.
Pick Category and add it. Choose Trend, keep is, and tick UPTREND.
Pick Filter and add NearSupport.
Add one more Filter: PatternBullish.
Three conditions, and all of them must pass.
Name the scan, save it, and press Run.
If one condition removes every stock, a note says so. Loosen it, or disable it for a moment, to see which part removes the stocks.
Information and education only, not investment advice.

scenes.title: Example 3: a group and an alert

lines.text: Example three uses a group. Pick Group and add it.
A group of Any of these passes when any one of its blocks passes: either, or.
With Extra screen functions switched on, you can add RsiDivergence as a filter, and a volume condition, the same way.
After a run, press Tell me when it matches.
Keep When the bar closes, the recommended choice, because the bar is final.
Connect Telegram in the same window if you want the message there.
Press Turn on the alert.
The alert is on. An alert only tells you; it never places or changes an order.
Information and education only, not investment advice.
